name: Steve Hotz
why_notable: Original author of dig, written at USC's Information Sciences Institute and first distributed publicly on 29 March 1989, with version 2.0 following on 1 September 1990. He built it by reworking pieces of the BIND resolver library and nslookup into a non-interactive, scriptable tool that printed the complete DNS message, flags and sections included, instead of only a final answer. Paul Vixie merged it into BIND 4.9, and dig went on to become the standard DNS diagnostic tool on every Unix-like system.
